name: massdns
summary: A high-performance DNS stub resolver in C.
highlights: -b — --bindto Bind to IP address and port. (Default: 0.0.0.0:0)
--busy-poll — Use busy-wait polling instead of epoll.
-c — --resolve-count Number of resolves for a name before giving up. (Default: 50)
--drop-group — Group to drop privileges to when running as root. (Default: nogroup)
--drop-user — User to drop privileges to when running as root. (Default: nobody)
--extended-input — Input names are followed by a space-separated list of resolvers. These are used before fal
--filter — Only output packets with the specified response code.
--flush — Flush the output file whenever a response was received.

flags.description: --bindto Bind to IP address and port. (Default: 0.0.0.0:0)

flags.name: --busy-poll
flags.description: Use busy-wait polling instead of epoll.

flags.description: --resolve-count Number of resolves for a name before giving up. (Default: 50)

flags.description: Group to drop privileges to when running as root. (Default: nogroup)

flags.name: --drop-user
flags.description: User to drop privileges to when running as root. (Default: nobody)

flags.description: Use non-recursive queries. Useful for DNS cache snooping.

flags.name: -o
flags.description: --output Flags for output formatting.

flags.name: --predictable
flags.description: Use resolvers incrementally. Useful for resolver tests.

flags.name: --processes
flags.description: Number of processes to be used for resolving. (Default: 1)

flags.name: -q
flags.description: --quiet Quiet mode.

flags.name: --rand-src-ipv6
flags.description: Use a random IPv6 address from the specified subnet for each query.

flags.name: --rcvbuf
flags.description: Size of the receive buffer in bytes.

flags.name: --retry

flags.default: All codes but NOERROR or NXDOMAIN

flags.name: -r
flags.description: --resolvers Text file containing DNS resolvers.

flags.name: --root
flags.description: Do not drop privileges when running as root. Not recommended.

flags.name: -s
flags.description: --hashmap-size Number of concurrent lookups. (Default: 10000)

flags.name: --sndbuf
flags.description: Size of the send buffer in bytes.

flags.name: --status-format
flags.description: Format for real-time status updates, json or ansi (Default: ansi)

flags.name: --sticky
flags.description: Do not switch the resolver when retrying.

flags.name: --socket-count
flags.description: Socket count per process. (Default: 1)

flags.name: -t
flags.description: --type Record type to be resolved. (Default: A)

flags.name: --verify-ip
flags.description: Verify IP addresses of incoming replies.

flags.name: -w
flags.description: --outfile Write to the specified output file instead of standard output.
